inputSnapshotRejected.reason: The only repository input for this bridge (scripts/fixtures/kherwara-project-input.ts, hfl 100.6 / 12 spans / spanLength 8 m) reproduces A = 141.5 m2, Q = 243.1 cumecs — which corpus/oracle/GOLDEN-ORACLE.json already lists under "superseded" as "A=141.5 vs 490.30; Q=243.1 vs 899.93". The oracle is therefore right and the repository input is known-wrong (its cross-section spans only 60 m against a 96 m waterway). SOM-KHW is frozen as EXPECTATIONS ONLY; gate:parity reports it as SKIP (never a silent pass). Owner: W02 verifier (Kiro) — requires a corrected cross-section for SOM-KHW.

perimeterRootCauseNote: Not probed for this bridge. The probe solves for the wetted perimeter implied by the oracle V, which requires the computed area to be correct first; here the computed area (141.5) is wrong because the only repository input is itself superseded, so any implied perimeter would be an artefact of that wrong area. The oracle states P directly for this bridge: 190.707 m (ARITH), against 60.773 m from the superseded cross-section.
